records.jp: なんだか、変な感じ
records.en_original: This feels weird.
records.en_auxiliary: This feels weird.
records.en: This feels weird.

records.jp: 教室をこんな風に改造して、<CR>自分の部屋みたいにくつろいでるって
records.en_original: Rearranging a classroom and relaxing in it like it's my bedroom.
records.en_auxiliary: Rearranging a classroom and relaxing in it like it's my bedroom.
records.en: We've remodeled a classroom like this,<CR>and now we're relaxing as if it were our own room.

records.jp: でもワクワクしない？<CR>普段勉強する場所をカスタマイズするの
records.en_original: Don't you think it's exciting we get to do whatever we want to a place that's usually just used for class?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you think it's exciting we get to do whatever we want to a place that's usually just used for class?
records.en: But isn't it exciting?<CR>Customizing a place that is normally used for studying.

records.jp: わかる気がする。<CR>いけないことをしてるみたい
records.en_original: I think I get what you mean. It's like we're rebelling.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I get what you mean. It's like we're rebelling.
records.en: I think I understand.<CR>It feels like we're doing something we shouldn't.

records.jp: 日菜子さんは何か置きたいものとかないの？
records.en_original: Do you have anything you'd like to put in here, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have anything you'd like to put in here, Hinako?
records.en: Do you have anything you'd like to put in here, Hinako-san?

records.jp: うーん、ぱっと思いつかないな。<CR>愛央は何置いてるの？
records.en_original: Hmm, nothing that comes to mind. How about you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, nothing that comes to mind. How about you, Ao?
records.en: Hmm, nothing that comes to mind.<CR>How about you, Ao?

records.jp: 私は……
records.en: As for me...

records.jp: よく使う雑貨かな。<CR>ポーチとか、マグカップとか
records.en_original: I guess the stuff I use everyday. Like my makeup bag and my favorite mug.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess the stuff I use everyday. Like my makeup bag and my favorite mug.
records.en: Everyday things I use a lot, I suppose.<CR>My pouch, a mug, things like that.

records.jp: 近くに置いておいた方が便利だからって、<CR>周りにどんどん物が増えてくやつだ
records.en_original: Putting stuff in your room just 'cause it's convenient is how you end up with a messy room.
records.en_auxiliary: Putting stuff in your room just 'cause it's convenient is how you end up with a messy room.
records.en: You keep things nearby because it's convenient,<CR>and before you know it, more and more stuff piles up around you.

records.jp: もしかして、日菜子さんの部屋ってこんな感じ……？
records.en_original: Does that mean...your room is like that, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: Does that mean...your room is like that, Hinako?
records.en: Does that mean...your room is like that, Hinako-san?

records.jp: ……まあ、整理されてるとは言えないかな
records.en_original: Well, I can't say that it's exactly clean...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I can't say that it's exactly clean...
records.en: Well, I can't say that it's exactly clean...

records.jp: 意外。しっかりしてると思ってた
records.en_original: That's surprising. I would have thought that you're the type to keep everything spotless.
records.en_auxiliary: That's surprising. I would have thought that you're the type to keep everything spotless.
records.en: That's surprising. I would have thought that you're the type to keep everything spotless.

records.jp: だって自分しかいない場所だし……。<CR>他人と使う場所なら整理しておくけどね
records.en_original: It's my own room so it's not like anyone else will see it... I always make sure to clean shared spaces though.
records.en_auxiliary: It's my own room so it's not like anyone else will see it... I always make sure to clean shared spaces though.
records.en: It's a place only I use...<CR>I keep shared spaces organized, though.

records.jp: 漫画かな
records.en_original: Maybe some manga?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe some manga?
records.en: Manga, maybe.

records.jp: なるほど、自分の好きなものを置くわけか
records.en_original: Something to do in your free time, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Something to do in your free time, huh?
records.en: I see. So you'd put things you like here.

records.jp: 日菜子さんも好きなものを置いたらどう？<CR>バレエの衣装とか
records.en_original: Why don't you bring something you can use to enjoy your hobbies too? Like one of your ballet outfits or something.
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you bring something you can use to enjoy your hobbies too? Like one of your ballet outfits or something.
records.en: Why don't you put something you like here too, Hinako-san?<CR>A ballet costume, for example.

records.jp: あのね、いくらバレエが好きだからって<CR>衣装を置いて悦に浸ったりはしないよ
records.en_original: I may like ballet, but what would I do with one of my costumes here?
records.en_auxiliary: I may like ballet, but what would I do with one of my costumes here?
records.en: Listen, no matter how much I like ballet,<CR>I wouldn't leave a costume here just to admire it.

records.jp: ご、ごめんなさい……。<CR>あんまり遊んでるイメージがわかなくて
records.en_original: S-sorry... I can't really imagine what you do in your free time.
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry... I can't really imagine what you do in your free time.
records.en: S-sorry...<CR>I just can't really picture what you do for fun.

records.jp: それは……確かにバレエばっかりだったから<CR>あんまり遊びには詳しくないけど
records.en_original: Well... It's true that ballet was everything to me. I guess I don't know much about enjoying myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... It's true that ballet was everything to me. I guess I don't know much about enjoying myself.
records.en: Well... It is true that ballet was most of my life,<CR>so I don't know much about ways to have fun.

records.jp: だからこそ、ここで色々教えてほしいかな
records.en_original: That's why I'd like to learn from you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I'd like to learn from you, Ao.
records.en: That is exactly why I'd like you to teach me all sorts of things here.

records.jp: そっか。<CR>もっと固い人なのかと思ってたからちょっと親近感
records.en_original: Really? I thought you were more uptight, but we may get along better than I thought.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I thought you were more uptight, but we may get along better than I thought.
records.en: I see.<CR>I thought you were more rigid, so I feel a little closer to you now.

records.jp: それにしても、本当に色々揃ってるね。<CR>漫画に冷蔵庫に、スマホの充電器……
records.en_original: Still, you've got quite the setup here. Manga, a fridge, a phone charger...
records.en_auxiliary: Still, you've got quite the setup here. Manga, a fridge, a phone charger...
records.en: Still, you really have all kinds of things here.<CR>Manga, a refrigerator, phone chargers...

records.jp: ねえ、もしかしていわゆるネットカフェって<CR>こういう感じ？
records.en_original: Is this what those "net cafe" things are like?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this what those "net cafe" things are like?
records.en: Hey, is this what those so-called net cafés<CR>are like?

records.jp: 行ったことないの？
records.en_original: Wait, you've never been to one?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, you've never been to one?
records.en: Wait, you've never been to one?

records.jp: うん。行く必要がなかったから
records.en_original: Nope. Never had any reason to go.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. Never had any reason to go.
records.en: Nope. Never had any reason to go.

records.jp: 一日中過ごせる楽園だよ。<CR>カップルシートを使えば友達とも遊べる
records.en_original: It's paradise! I could spend the whole day there. Plus you can bring a friend if you get the couple's plan!
records.en_auxiliary: It's paradise! I could spend the whole day there. Plus you can bring a friend if you get the couple's plan!
records.en: They're paradise—you can spend all day there.<CR>And with a couple seat, you can hang out with a friend too.

records.jp: カップル……！？
records.en_original: Couple...?!
records.en_auxiliary: Couple...?!
records.en: Couple...?!

records.jp: 愛央、進んでるなあ……私には相手がいないから<CR>利用できなさそうだよ
records.en_original: I didn't think you'd have so much experience... I'm not dating anyone, so I don't think I would be able to use it...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't think you'd have so much experience... I'm not dating anyone, so I don't think I would be able to use it...
records.en: You're rather advanced, Ao... I don't have a partner,<CR>so I suppose I couldn't use one.

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh?
records.en: ...Huh?

records.jp: いや、単なる二人用の席だからね！？<CR>カップルじゃないと使えない席とかじゃないから！
records.en_original: No, no! It's just a booth for two people! It's not exclusively for couples!
records.en_auxiliary: No, no! It's just a booth for two people! It's not exclusively for couples!
records.en: No, it's just a seat for two people!<CR>You don't have to be a couple to use it!

records.jp: あ、そうなんだ。<CR>これは恥ずかしい……
records.en_original: Oh... I see. How embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... I see. How embarrassing...
records.en: Oh... I see.<CR>How embarrassing...

records.jp: 必要が無くても経験するのが大事！<CR>新しい遊びも友達に紹介できないよ！
records.en_original: You don't need a reason! Sometimes it's good to just try new things out. How else are you going to introduce your friends to things!
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need a reason! Sometimes it's good to just try new things out. How else are you going to introduce your friends to things!
records.en: Even if you do not need to, trying things is important!<CR>Otherwise you cannot introduce new ways to have fun to your friends!

records.jp: そっか、そうだよね。<CR>思えばいつも友達に教えてもらってばかりだったな
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right. Come to think of it, my friends were always the ones introducing me to new things.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you're right. Come to think of it, my friends were always the ones introducing me to new things.
records.en: I see. You're right.<CR>Come to think of it, my friends were always the ones teaching me things.

records.jp: 私ももっと自分から遊びに誘えるようになりたいし
records.en_original: Besides, I want to start inviting them to hang out instead of the other way around.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, I want to start inviting them to hang out instead of the other way around.
records.en: Besides, I want to start inviting them to hang out instead of the other way around.

records.jp: いろんなことに興味を向けてものを知らないとなあ。<CR>心がけてるつもりだけど、まだまだだ
records.en_original: I've been trying to learn about a lot of different things, but looks like I still have a long way to go.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been trying to learn about a lot of different things, but looks like I still have a long way to go.
records.en: I need to take an interest in all sorts of things and learn more.<CR>I thought I was trying to, but I still have a long way to go.

records.jp: その心意気やよし！
records.en_original: Don't give up!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't give up!
records.en: That is the spirit!

records.jp: ということで、新しいものを知ろう！<CR>おすすめの漫画があるからソファで読もうよ！
records.en_original: Let's do something new right now: chill on the sofa and read!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's do something new right now: chill on the sofa and read!
records.en: So, let us learn about something new!<CR>I have some manga to recommend, so let us read it on the sofa!

records.jp: うん、いいよ
records.en_original: Sure. Let's do it.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Let's do it.
records.en: Sure. Let's do it.

records.jp: そっちの教室にもあると思うけどさ、<CR>このソファよくない？好きな時にごろっとできるし
records.en_original: I know there's one in the other classroom too, but isn't having a sofa the best? You can sprawl out whenever you want!
records.en_auxiliary: I know there's one in the other classroom too, but isn't having a sofa the best? You can sprawl out whenever you want!
records.en: I know there's one in the other classroom too,<CR>but isn't having a sofa the best? You can sprawl out whenever you want!

records.jp: 日菜子さんも、ずっと椅子に座って<CR>授業受けてるとさ、横になりたくなる時あるっしょ
records.en_original: You always sit in your chair during class, don't you just wanna lie down sometimes?
records.en_auxiliary: You always sit in your chair during class, don't you just wanna lie down sometimes?
records.en: When you've been sitting in a chair through<CR>class all day, don't you sometimes want to lie down too, Hinako-san?

records.jp: 姿勢変えたり、<CR>身体伸ばしたくなったりすることはあるけど
records.en_original: I guess there are times I want to change positions, or stretch my legs.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess there are times I want to change positions, or stretch my legs.
records.en: I guess there are<CR>times I want to change positions, or stretch my legs.

records.jp: でしょ？<CR>はぁーあ……
records.en_original: Right? *sigh*
records.en_auxiliary: Right? *sigh*
records.en: Right?<CR>*sigh*

records.jp: この椅子で授業受けられたらいいのに
records.en_original: I wish I could take my classes like this.
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could take my classes like this.
records.en: I wish we could take class in this chair.

records.jp: 先生は立ったままで？
records.en_original: While the teacher is standing?
records.en_auxiliary: While the teacher is standing?
records.en: While the teacher is standing?

records.jp: 先生も寝そべっちゃおう
records.en_original: The teacher can lie down, too!
records.en_auxiliary: The teacher can lie down, too!
records.en: The teacher can lie down too.

records.jp: 黒板書きづらくない？
records.en_original: But wouldn't it be hard to write on the chalkboard?
records.en_auxiliary: But wouldn't it be hard to write on the chalkboard?
records.en: But wouldn't it be hard to write on the chalkboard?

records.jp: 別に書かなくてよくない？
records.en_original: They don't have to write anything if they don't want to.
records.en_auxiliary: They don't have to write anything if they don't want to.
records.en: They do not really have to write on it, do they?

records.jp: この椅子で授業受けたいっていうより、<CR>ただ寝たいだけでしょ
records.en_original: If you used this for class, all you'd want to do is sleep.
records.en_auxiliary: If you used this for class, all you'd want to do is sleep.
records.en: Rather than wanting to take class in this chair,<CR>you simply want to sleep, don't you?

records.jp: あはは、バレた～
records.en_original: Ahahaha, you got me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahahaha, you got me!
records.en: Ahahaha, you got me!

records.jp: 学校にもお昼寝タイムがあればいいのに
records.en_original: I wish we could sleep during lectures.
records.en_auxiliary: I wish we could sleep during lectures.
records.en: I wish school had nap time too.

records.jp: うーん、私はそれはいいかな
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't think I do.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I don't think I do.
records.en: Hmm... I don't think I do.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: How come?
records.en_auxiliary: How come?
records.en: How come?

records.jp: 一回寝ちゃうと、起きる時が辛そうだから。<CR>緊張の糸が切れてだらけちゃいそう
records.en_original: Once I go to sleep, it's hard to wake back up. I wouldn't be able to focus.
records.en_auxiliary: Once I go to sleep, it's hard to wake back up. I wouldn't be able to focus.
records.en: Once I fell asleep, waking up would be hard.<CR>I feel like I would lose all tension and become lazy.

records.jp: そういう考え方もあるか
records.en_original: I guess that's another way of looking at it.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess that's another way of looking at it.
records.en: I guess that's another way of looking at it.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
